project_summary: Multi-vendor marketplace with seller onboarding, commission engine, and dispute resolution

components.name: Marketplace core (Django)
components.description: Product listings, categories, search with PostgreSQL full-text, and seller storefront pages.

components.name: Seller onboarding and KYC
components.description: Registration wizard, document upload to S3, manual review queue, and automated company registry validation.

components.name: Commission and payout engine
components.description: Tiered commission rules, escrow holds, and weekly payout batches with accounting export.

components.name: Dispute resolution workflow
components.description: Buyer-seller messaging, evidence attachments, and admin arbitration with refund triggers.

components.name: Seller analytics dashboard
components.description: Sales trends, conversion funnels, and inventory turnover charts embedded in seller portal.
